question: Find the value of ((sec⁴A-sec²A))/((cot⁴A+cot²A))times ((cosec⁴A-cosec²A))/((tan²A+tan⁴A))+cot²A
solution:
**Given:**

 ((sec⁴A-sec²A))/((cot⁴A+cot²A))times ((cosec⁴A-cosec²A))/((tan²A+tan⁴A))+cot²A 

**Formula Used:**

sec²A = 1 + tan²A

cosec²A = 1 + cot²A

tanA × cotA = 1

**Calculation:**

** ((sec⁴A-sec²A))/((cot⁴A+cot²A))times ((cosec⁴A-cosec²A))/((tan²A+tan⁴A))+cot²A **</p&g
